payload.title: Console pages are listed in several workspaces at once (alarms, tasks, maintenance, storage, finance, team pages, roles, AI chat, equipment) and the definitions spec requires it, so a URL's workspace and its HR module scope depend on navigation history instead of the URL
evidence: web/shell/src/console/nav/__tests__/definitions.spec.ts:49-65 (asserts that the shared set stays in more than one workspace)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/shared.ts:20-65 (overview and team areas are carried by every module workspace)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/ctl.ts:73-87 (Control & sensors lists farm-module pages: maintenance, equipment, tasks, storage, farm finance)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaces/gh.ts:27-40 (Greenhouse lists farm site work and farm finance)
web/shell/src/console/nav/workspaceForPath.ts:58-63 (a URL claimed by several workspaces keeps the current one)
web/shell/src/console/ConsoleShell.tsx:125-129 (HR pages are scoped to the followed workspace's module)
payload.rule_violated: Plan PKG-36: every URL maps to exactly one workspace, and messaging is the only shared page.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-36, release R11.
